{{Quote|Grand Admiral Batch was assassinated by his second in command, who then took the ships of Batch's task force and joined Warlord Harrsk in the Deep Core.|[[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|''The New Essential Chronology'']]|<ref name="NEC" />}}
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Martio Batch]] had command of a '''task force''' composed of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="NEC" /> Following the [[Mission to Imdaar|loss]] of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Terror]]''<ref name="Who's Who" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Batch took the ships of his<ref name="Who's Who" /> task force<ref name="NEC" /> and withdrew to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for months.<ref name="Who's Who" /> In around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}} establishes that following [[Martio Batch]]'s [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], his crew joined the newly-formed [[Zero Command|splinter kingdom]] led by [[Blitzer Harrsk]]. As ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that Harrsk's splinter faction was formed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the assassiation of Batch and the subsequent assimilation into Harrsk's faction must have taken place around that year.</ref> following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in that same year, the [[Martio Batch's second in command|second in command]],<ref name="NEC" /> with the help of the crew<ref name="Who's Who" /> of the task force, assassinated Batch.<ref name="NEC" /> Following the assassination, [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]] recruited the crew,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and Batch's second in command took the ships of the task force to join<ref name="NEC" /> Harrsk's splinter kingom,<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Zero Command]].<ref name="TEA" />
